title: classify step config
description: Runs a classifier on a context field and writes the top label and its score.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published classifier model.

input_field.description: Context key holding the text to classify; an empty value skips the step with a warning.

output_field.description: Context key receiving the top label; the score lands in <output_field>.score.

threshold.description: Minimum score carried to downstream readers; the executor itself does not filter on it, and 0 is not sent.
